title: No-Show Record and Reserved-Slot Booking in Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
### Clause

Before a Repair Estimates & Appointments booking is made, the customer's no-shows are counted over the rolling window of the no-show look-back days, in calendar days, ending on (and including) the date of the new booking request. A no-show counts when it is one of the customer's estimate bookings in no-show status whose no-show was recorded on a date inside that window.

- When the count is **at or above** the no-show limit, only an estimate type that does not reserve a slot (Photo Estimate or Drive-In Estimate) may be booked; a type that reserves capacity is refused for that request, whatever the payer.
- When the count is **below** the limit, every estimate type remains open, subject to the estimate type acceptance rules.
- Cancelled bookings are not no-shows and never count.

### Applying the clause

| No-shows in the window, compared with the limit | Photo Estimate / Drive-In Estimate | Scheduled, Mobile, Blueprint Teardown or Structural Blueprint Estimate |
|---|---|---|
| At or above the limit | May be booked | Refused for this request, whatever the payer |
| Below the limit | Open, subject to acceptance | Open, subject to acceptance |

Worked counts (hypothetical customers, with the limit of 2 and the 365-day look-back that every estimate type carries):

1. Two no-shows recorded inside the window and one cancelled booking: the count is 2, at the limit; a Scheduled Estimate is refused for this request, a Drive-In Estimate may be booked.
2. One no-show inside the window and three cancellations: the count is 1, below the limit; every type is open, subject to acceptance.
3. Two no-shows, one of them recorded before the window began: only the one inside the window counts; the count is 1.
